ns2:course.label: Venture Funded Startups
ns2:course.description: Concepts, tools, and language used by venture capitalists (VCs). Venture-scale opportunity assessment and articulation; venture capital financing and valuation; deal structure; term sheets; financial plans for startups; customer development and marketing; product iterations; sales execution. 1 graduate hour. No professional credit. Prerequisite: TE 566.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 1 graduate hour. No professional credit. Prerequisite: TE 566.
